failureReason: The model attempted to implement inline server actions in ContactForm.tsx but made architectural errors across all runs. In runs 1-2, it incorrectly split the implementation into two files (ContactForm.tsx and ContactFormFields.tsx), when a single Server Component was needed. In run 3, it incorrectly placed both 'use client' and 'use server' directives in the same file, which violates Next.js rules. The model failed to understand the proper way to define inline server actions directly in a Server Component.
